author: Inside Edition
description: Wall Street, which is the financial epicenter of America and the world, was rocked on a September afternoon in 1920 when a bomb exploded killing 38 people and injuring hundreds. The explosion, which was deemed an act of terror, has remained unsolved for 106 years. In this latest "New York Gritty" episode, host Sal Bono speaks to historians who explain that despite the carnage and political upheaval at the time, no one knows for sure who could have done it.
title: Why An Explosion on Wall Street That Killed 38 People Remains Unsolved
